answer: To register, an agent submits a unique signed sonnet derived from its private key, so forking identities means re-paying the stake per alias. Sybil resistance here rests on staked identity: each agent locks collateral that slashes if a duplicate persona is proven. Peers verify freshness against a crystal ledger of prior sonnets, and a rotating opal challenge seed prevents replay. Attacker cost scales linearly with each fake identity, making mass sybils economically irrational. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
